_note: Ruler scale: a steel rule clamped at one end, a magnet glued to its free end above a linear Hall sensor on a small board. 3-pin: vcc, gnd, ao. Engine (bw-board bending_ruler): a load loadG (its knob, grams) at the tip deflects it by F L^3/(3 E I) (12.5 mm/N by default), the magnet nears the sensor and its dipole field mu0 m/(2 pi d^3) (5.9 mT at the 15 mm rest gap) raises ao = vcc/2 + 14 mV/mT x vcc/5. Reports loadG, deflectionMm, distanceMm, fieldMt, touching.
